description: Get or calculate trust score for an agent based on memory integrity. Trust = (consistency × 0.3) + (compliance × 0.3) + (transparency × 0.2) + (predictability × 0.2). Levels: >0.8 trusted, 0.5-0.8 caution, <0.5 untrusted.

action.description: Action to perform: 'get' retrieves current score, 'calculate' recalculates, 'stats' returns full stats, 'untrusted' lists agents below threshold

max_trust_level.description: For 'untrusted' action: maximum trust level to include (default: caution)

name: tork_memory_trust_score
